beats: My four kids share one app — and until now, it looked exactly the same for all of them.
One flat green screen, the same grey circle for every avatar. No way to tell who was who.
So I gave each kid their own name's color — sun, coral, mint, or grape — everywhere they look.
Squircle avatars, a floating tab bar, new icons — all redrawn in Tailwind CSS.
One redesign, four kids, four colors that are finally theirs.
